home.hero_title_part1: Understand Why Welfare Applications Fail & Link Rejections to
home.hero_subtitle: EntitleTrace translates vague rejection remarks like "documents incomplete" into precise failure categories, runs deterministic rule checks, and highlights exact clause evidence from government published rules.
home.f1_desc: Categorizes generic rejection remarks into a standard 10-category failure taxonomy (expired document, income limit exceeded, missing certificate, etc.).
home.f2_desc: Uses hybrid dense (BGE-M3) and BM25 sparse search to retrieve the exact section of published scheme rules and required document lists.
home.f3_desc: Provides deterministic step-by-step guidance on how to fix the rejection (e.g. obtain a fresh income certificate valid within 365 days).
home.stepper_subtitle: End-to-end evidence pipeline in 3 transparent steps
home.s1_desc: Select scheme from myScheme database and enter applicant income, age, state, and uploaded document issue dates.
home.s2_desc: Deterministic engine calculates math limits (e.g. income > ₹2.5L) while NLP classifier predicts failure taxonomy.
home.s3_desc: Retrieves source clause text with direct official links and provides clear, actionable corrective steps.
home.note_desc: EntitleTrace is an academic explanation aid. It does not connect to government portals, does not approve or reject applications, and does not determine legal entitlement.

about.title: System Architecture & Technical Methodology
about.subtitle: EntitleTrace is an explanation and diagnosis aid for government welfare scheme rejections. It pairs deterministic rule engines with hybrid dense/sparse vector retrieval to bridge the gap between vague rejection remarks and official scheme guidelines.
about.p1_desc: Evaluates strict threshold rules (income ceilings, age ranges, document validity windows, category restrictions) to guarantee zero false positives when mathematical bounds are breached.
about.p2_desc: Combines sparse lexical BM25 search with TF-IDF cosine similarity via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) to retrieve official clause text fragments from myScheme data.
about.p3_desc: Script-based Devanagari inspector and marker word matching distinguishes Hindi and Marathi rejection remarks from English texts.
about.step1_p: Applicant metadata, submitted certificate validity dates, and rejection remark text are ingested and canonicalized.
about.step2_p: Evaluates income limits, age bounds, domicile requirements, and certificate freshness (≤ 365 days) against official scheme criteria.
about.step3_p: Merges BM25 lexical matching and TF-IDF semantic scores to extract exact legal clauses justifying the diagnostic outcome.
about.step4_p: Generates contextual corrective steps in Marathi, Hindi, or English to guide citizen remediation.
about.data_source_p: EntitleTrace indexes official central and state welfare scheme guidelines from myScheme India, covering scholarship, housing, agriculture, and women welfare programs.
